development_statistics.return_observation: one complete UTC-day base-net portfolio return, compounded from that day's 143 non-overlapping ten-minute intervals after funding and realized-turnover costs

newey_west.estimator: Bartlett-kernel HAC t statistic for the arithmetic mean daily base-net return

selection_bias.single_trial_rule: The sole preregistered Alpha 015 configuration may report PBO as NOT_APPLICABLE_SINGLE_PREREGISTERED_TRIAL. This is not a PBO pass and cannot be used for live or portfolio promotion.
selection_bias.multiple_trial_rule: A second model, timing, universe, cost, or portfolio variation is outside Experiment 0015. If a future independently preregistered family contains multiple trials, it must use eight-slice CSCV/PBO; it may not invoke the single-trial exemption.

interpretation: These are development-screening diagnostics only. Alpha 015 cannot become live-eligible from this gate; portfolio promotion retains its separate 252-observation, multi-sleeve, locked-forward selection-bias requirements.
unchanged: all PnL, cost, timing, model, and universe choices
locked validation remains inaccessible until every development gate passes
